主要内容: SanDisk Corporation implemented a Non-Employee Director Compensation Policy effective June 13, 2013. The policy outlines compensation terms for non-employee directors, including cash retainers for meetings and conference calls, and grants of stock options and restricted stock units based on the average closing price of its shares on NASDAQ. Additionally, the company announced restrictions on share-based compensation for non-employee board members, limiting the total number of shares an individual may receive in a single calendar year to 150,000 through various awards. Performance-based awards under the Stock Issuance and Cash Bonus Program are capped at $10,000,000 annually. The Compensation Committee administers these programs for Section 16 officers, while the Board retains control for other participants. Discretionary awards to Compensation Committee members require approval by a disinterested majority of the Board.
